Appreciate the summary. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Production and backups: yes, production datasets (including model inputs/outputs that contain PII) must be stored and backed up within the EU. We cannot tolerate backups that replicate to non-EU regions without prior approval.
- Logs: we can accept telemetry but only if PII is redacted before leaving customer-controlled storage, or if you provide explicit guarantees about what is logged. Ideally we want the ability to configure redaction rules and a retention window (30–90 days).

Hi all —

Thanks for the clear notes, John. Quick technical answers (short bullets you can share):

- Region pinning: Redwood supports strict region pinning per customer. You can configure a primary region (EU-FRA) where all ingest, model I/O, and persistent storage live. We will not replicate customer data outside the pinned region unless explicitly enabled by the customer.

- Backups: We offer backups/snapshots that can be configured to remain in the pinned region (EU) only. Geo-replication to other regions is an opt-in setting and requires an explicit configuration change and documented customer approval.

- Cross-region failover / DR: Failover modes are configurable: 
  * Manual failover (recommended for strict-residency customers): operations initiated by customer or Redwood SRE after approval.
  * Controlled automated failover: can be enabled but limited to metadata-only routing; persistent data movement still respects the region-pin setting unless an override is approved.

- Logging & telemetry: Audit logs and request logs can be configured to redact fields using regex-based hooks or to send only hashed identifiers. Retention windows are configurable at the tenant level (e.g., 30/60/90/365 days). Logs can be exported to customer-owned S3 or pushed to their SIEM via TLS with mTLS.

- Encryption & KMS: We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) using major cloud KMS providers and can integrate with HSM-backed providers for additional assurances. Snapshots and backups are encrypted at rest with the chosen key.

- Compliance artifacts: see attached SOC2 summary and region playbook. Additional artifacts (pen tests, architecture diagrams) can be shared under an NDA or via a secure document portal.

Next steps:
1) If acceptable, schedule 30-min call with your security/compliance team and our solutions engineers. I can do 10:30–11:00 PT tomorrow.
2) If Sarah wants, we can provision a short environment that demonstrates region pinning behavior (demo only; no production data).
